name: Good sunglasses

lead: Sunglasses are tinted or polarised eyewear that reduces glare and ultraviolet exposure. Frame shape also changes how the face reads.
In style advice they are used to balance facial proportions and add polish. The visual effect is instant, though no specific scholarly literature was reviewed here.

paras: Tinted lenses cut visible light and UV, while frame shape, width and bridge alter perceived proportions.
Poorly rated lenses can let UV in; check UV400 or equivalent labelling. Frames that fit badly are uncomfortable. The effect lasts only while worn.
